subject: literacy
concept: Hearing and identifying individual sounds (phonemes) within spoken words
source_inspiration: adapted from Mississippi Science-of-Reading phonemic awareness sequencing principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student claps once for each sound heard in a spoken word (e.g. c-a-t = 3 claps)
exercise.pictorial: Student matches spoken words to the correct number of sound-boxes
exercise.abstract: Student identifies the first sound heard in a spoken word

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
